anomalies.observed: In the 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)' block on the root sheet (PCB.kicad_sch), the global labels NET0012 (driven by U2 pin 37 / PB5) and NET0015 (driven by U2 pin 39 / PB7) are tied together on a single wire node. That same merged node also carries C24 (22 nF) to GND and R12 (1 kΩ) to the A1 'BTN' electrode. Thus PB5 and PB7 are shorted and both the series resistor and the sampling capacitor sit on the same net.
anomalies.expected: The specification §3 defines these as two separate nets: 'TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin BTN' and 'TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND)'. The 1 kΩ series resistor must be on the electrode pin (PB5) and the 22 nF sampling capacitor must be on the separate Cs pin (PB7); they must not share a node.

evidence.quote: Root sheet 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)': C24 22n to GND, NET0015 and NET0012 labels both landing on the wire that also feeds R12 1k to A1 pin 1 (BTN)

anomalies.impact: The STM32 TSC Group-2 electrode pin and sampling-capacitor pin are shorted together, and the sampling capacitor is placed directly on the electrode node. This defeats the charge-transfer measurement, so the capacitive touch button will not work, and the two GPIOs are in contention.
